codeReview.summary: The retry/resend UI mostly matches the requested flow, but the client wires the retry mutation to `messageId` instead of the required delivery-log entry ID. This breaks the service/API contract established by the retry endpoint and can fail whenever `messageId` differs from the delivery log row identifier.

issues.description: `bookingService.retryEmailDelivery` is invoked with `{ deliveryLogId: pendingRetryAttempt.messageId }`, but the feature contract and service method both expect a delivery-log entry ID, not the provider message ID. The same mismatch is baked into the new tests. Because `OpsEmailDeliveryAttemptDTO.messageId` is a provider message ID, retries can target the wrong record or be rejected entirely when the API validates against the actual delivery-log row id.
